CONTEXT_SCANNER.ON_HIT: HARD_FAIL: the call is not made and the run is invalid until the context is fixed
CONTEXT_SCANNER.RESIDUAL_RISK: The existence of a consumed region and the wording of mechanisms cannot be fully outcome-neutral; accepted and recorded.

GENERATOR_EVALUATION_CRITERIA.ANTI_GOODHART: Downstream scientific classifications of executed candidates are never a generator reward signal and never enter generator or selector context.
BATCH_METRICS: human active minutes per accepted candidate
GENERATOR_EVALUATION_CRITERIA.HUMAN_BASELINE: No timed historical baseline exists. The first real campaign logs human minutes; comparisons to Sprint03/04 effort are labelled estimates.
GENERATOR_EVALUATION_CRITERIA.KPI: Reduce active human hypothesis-discovery effort by about 70-80% without lowering scientific quality (quality = the dimensions above plus human acceptance).
GENERATOR_EVALUATION_CRITERIA.SCALE: ordinal per dimension (e.g. 0-3) recorded separately; no single opaque total score

HARD_FAIL_CRITERIA: candidate contains a probability-of-success or expected-alpha field
uses information after the decision time (lookahead)
applies a forbidden transformation to a consumed signature
blocked DATA_STATUS without an exactly named missing observable
data source outside DATA_CATALOG_V0 claimed as DATA_READY
HUMAN_MUTATION_RULE: Any human edit to a generated card is recorded as an explicit mutation (field, before, after, reason); no silent edits
HUMAN_ROLE: approve/reject batch shortlist with logged reasons
